purpose: Requirements for the ADR writer, an isolated agent that judges, rejects, repairs and records architecture decision records separately from the design flow, with verdicts of created, rejected or insufficient.
summary: Overview and scope of the ADR writer as an isolated subject that examines and records ADRs
Glossary: request types (approval record, judgment record, update) and verdicts (created, rejected, insufficient)
Request intake rules with required content per request type
Rejection criteria for judgment records and repair rules for malformed ADRs
Handling of insufficient information: return what is missing instead of inventing
Approval records are never rejected, only checked for completeness
Updating existing decisions by rewriting the same section, moving rejected ideas to alternatives
Verdict return contract and treating incomplete runs as failures
Output location: one ADR file per feature, ADR-{NNN}_{feature}.md, write scope limited to ADR files
Invocation path, start-design decoupling, single source of norms, isolation and failure visibility requirements
tasks: Designing or implementing the ADR writer agent or skill
Requesting an ADR from start-design or other skills
Recording user approval for designs not covered by requirements
Reviewing ADR-related documents for requirement conformance
Deciding whether a decision deserves an ADR
Updating or retracting an existing ADR decision
Handling ADR writer verdicts in a calling skill
title: REQ-030 ADR ライター 要件定義書
